$comment: DRAFT ship-readiness checklist scaffolded by /prepare-for-swarm for AWS Lambda. These gates must all pass before promoting to production.

gates.description: Build step (`sam build`) succeeds with zero warnings.
No secrets, keys, or credentials committed or inlined in config.
Previous good release identifier recorded; rollback command known.
Any data migrations are forward-only and reviewed.
Deployed URL/version and verify result pasted into the PR description.

$comment-goalIds: Optional. The user lists the goal IDs this gate should block, e.g. ["goal-1"]. Empty means the gate applies to no specific goal until filled in.
$comment-smokeEndpoints: Optional. Each entry is { url, expectStatus, jsonPath, expectEquals }: poll url, assert HTTP status === expectStatus, and optionally assert the JSON value at jsonPath equals expectEquals.
